verdict.root_cause: The page starts the deduplication run without the content type the service requires, so the service refuses the request before it can return results.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent correctly clicked the named deduplication button, which immediately produced the failing POST request. Pressing Enter later repeated the same valid button activation only after the first request had already failed; it did not cause the missing content type or the hidden results.
